name: hud_sensor_tracker_get_save_state_relative_vector_len
description: HudSensorTracker::GetSaveStateRelativeVectorLen computes a save-state position delta from the tracked origin, zeroes the Y component, and returns either XZ length-squared or length.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because it names zUtil_SaveGameState and player-state overlay fields imprecisely in the x87 expression, although the field offsets match playerState->worldPos.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x416e50 has no warnings or tags and subtracts tracker->trackedWorldOriginPtr from saveState->playerState->worldPos, clears relativeDelta.y, and returns either the squared length or sqrt(lengthSq).
The native HUD save-marker leaf smoke verifies XZ delta storage, Y zeroing, length-squared return, and square-root return.
